$description: Design tokens for the HarrisonGPT frontend. The UI renders beside scans of printed Harrison's pages served from /pages/*, so the ground is warm paper rather than white and the ink is warm-neutral rather than black.

paper.use: app background — warm so page scans don't read as dingy grey

surface.use: answer column, panels that must lift off the paper

well.use: recessed areas: page-scan rail, code, evidence blocks

600.use: citations, links, primary button — Harrison oxblood

100.use: citation chip hover fill, tint backgrounds

confidence.$rule: Deliberately NOT in the accent family. Confidence must never be confused with a link or a brand element, and must never be signalled by colour alone — every state carries a glyph and a word.

low.note: Slate, not red. Low confidence is uncertainty, not an error — red over-signals and would collide with the oxblood accent.

refusal.$rule: REFUSAL_STR is rendered verbatim and unsoftened (CODING_RULES 3.2). It is a distinct state, not a low-confidence answer.

typography.$rule: System stacks only — no webfont download. The answer is textbook prose set beside a scanned textbook page, so it is serif; UI chrome is sans; anything numeric or page-referencing is mono.

family.serif: Charter, "Bitstream Charter", "Iowan Old Style", "Source Serif 4", Georgia, serif
family.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

body.use: answer prose — 17px, not 14px; this is read, not scanned

measure.use: hard max-width on the answer column

radius.$rule: Rounding is meaningful, not decorative. A book page is a rectangle — rounding a scan is a lie about the artefact.

elevation.$rule: Paper does not float. Structure comes from 1px ink-100 borders, not shadows. Exactly one shadow exists in the system.

motion.$rule: No scroll-triggered animation. One looping animation exists — the wait skeleton — because /ask blocks for 10-40s with no token stream.
motion.reduced_motion: All durations collapse to 0ms under prefers-reduced-motion; the skeleton becomes a static bar.

split.$rule: Below md the right rail collapses; citations open the scan in a sheet instead of scrolling a rail.

touch_target.exception: Inline citation chips sit in prose at ~24px and cannot be 44px without breaking leading. They are mirrored in the full-size source list below the answer, which meets 44px.

dark_mode.status: deferred — deliberately not shipped in v1
dark_mode.reason: Every page scan is white paper. In a dark shell they glow like lightboxes and dominate the layout. Shipping it half-done is worse than not shipping it. All values already route through tokens, so adding it later is one [data-theme] block, not a refactor. It will need filter: brightness(.88) contrast(1.05) on scan wells.
